Name: BDD: ERL: Informatica: Check two addresses are suggested

Summary:
User Story:
GWA-22267
Product:
Office
Brand:
RC EU
(France,Germany,Netherlands,Ireland,Singapore)
/AU/EU/UK/Avaya
(France/Netherlands/Ireland/AU)
/ATT UB
(France,Austria, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Spain,Belguim)/BT
Account type(/s):
Admin

Preconditions:
Entry point(/s):
Create unconfirmed admin account with SP 1075=2
Add cookie "force_erl_validation" = 1 and
Two suggested  addresses
from
ES-16907
before opening activation link
Proceed till ERL step
Notes:
To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

Steps:
Step: Click "Edit" button
Click "Update my location info" button
Expected: The following pop-up is displayed:
Title:
"Confirm your address"
Text:
"We found multiple addresses that match the information that you entered.  Please check the suggestions below and choose the correct address."
The 2 addresses from cookie configuration are displayed next to radiobuttons.
Buttons:
"Back"
"Continue" - disabled

Step: Pick one address from the list and click "Continue"
Expected: ERL address is updated

Summary:

Product:

(France/Netherlands/Ireland/AU)
/ATT UB
(France,Austria, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Spain,Belguim)/BT
Account type(/s):
Admin

Preconditions:
Entry point(/s):
Create unconfirmed admin account with SP 1075=2
Add cookie "force_erl_validation" = 1 and
No matching address
from
ES-16907
before opening activation link
Proceed till ERL step
Notes:
To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

Steps:
Step: Enter "
2300 ELM STREET, FOSTER CITY, CA, 94070, United States
" data as Address
Expected: The following pop-up is displayed:
Title:
"No matching address found"
Text:
"
We were unable to find an address matching the information you entered.
Please check the address for mistakes and resubmit.
"
Button:
"Back"

Step: Click
"Back" button
Enter existing and valid ERL
Confirm address
Expected: ERL address is updated

Name: BDD: ERL: Informatica: Check 1 address is suggested

Summary:
User Story:
GWA-22267
Product:
Office
Brand:
RC EU
(France,Germany,Netherlands,Ireland,Singapore)
/AU/EU/UK/Avaya
(France/Netherlands/Ireland/AU)
/ATT UB
(France,Austria, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Spain,Belguim)/BT
Account type(/s):
Admin

Preconditions:
Entry point(/s):
Create unconfirmed admin account with SP 1075=2
Add cookie "force_erl_validation" = 1 and
One suggested  address
from
ES-16907
before opening activation link
Proceed till ERL step
Notes:
To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

Steps:
Step: Click "Edit" button
Click "Update my location info" button
Expected: The following pop-up is displayed:
Title:
"Confirm your address"
Text:
"We found the following address that seems to match the information that you entered.  Please check the address below and confirm if this is the correct address."
Blue check mark icon
Address from cookie configuration
Buttons:
"Back"
"Continue"

Step: Click "Continue" button
Expected: ERL address is updated

Name: Integration: Check 1DL account is sampled as "ftue type=single_visual_ftue" for Office flow

Summary:
User Story:
GWA-19773
,
GWA-23076
Product:
Office
Account type(/s):
Admin
Brand:
RC US

Preconditions:
Entry points:
1.
Create unconfrirmed admin account
via AGS
2. Set custom data:
{
    "userId": "userId",
    "method": "PUT",
    "url": "/restapi/v1.0/client-info/custom-data/
licenseqty",
    "body": {
         "id":"licenseqty",
"value":"1"
},
    "api": "https://api-devgwsams.int.rclabenv.com",
    "brandId": "1210",
    "debug": "1",
    "serialize": "0"
}
Notes:
The test is automated and all steps and checks you can find in
https://git.ringcentral.com/AUT.Projects/CW-AES
project

Steps:
Step: Test is automated
Expected: Automation test has to run with status pass
